definition.name: Accidental Death & Dismemberment
definition.description: If you die as a result of an accident, the life insurance company will double the original death benefit of your policy.

definition.name: Waiver of Premium Rider
definition.description: Waives your premium payments should you become totally disabled before age 60; see brochure/certificate for details.

definition.name: Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D) Rider
definition.description: If you die as a result of an accident, the life insurance company will double the original death benefit of your policy.

definition.name: Chronic Illness Rider (CIR)
definition.description: Chronic illness coverage from $50,000 to $1,000,000 for members and $25,000 to $1,000,000 for spouses.

definition.name: Future Purchase Option (FPO)
definition.description: Source-linked candidate rider; rates unavailable.

definition.name: Chronic Illness Rider (CIR)
definition.description: Source-linked candidate rider; rates unavailable.

definition.name: Chronic Illness Rider (CIR)
definition.description: Accelerate up to 50% of the portion of your life insurance subject to the Chronic Illness Rider should you be permanently unable to perform 2 out of 6 activities of daily living or require substantial care due to permanent cognitive impairment.

definition.name: Automatic Benefit Increase Rider (ABI)
definition.description: Automatic benefit increase of $25,000 per year for up to 10 years, with no additional medical underwriting required. Subject to increased premium due with each annual increase.
